## Auth Flows (ForgeRock AM)

| Flow | Protocol | MFA | Test Scenarios |
|---|---|---|---|
| Customer login | OAuth2/OIDC (auth code + PKCE) | Yes | Valid, invalid creds, locked, expired token, MFA bypass attempt |
| Service-to-service | OAuth2 client credentials | No | Valid scope, invalid scope, expired client secret |
| Admin login | OAuth2/OIDC | Yes (step-up) | Valid, privilege escalation from customer role |
| <!-- AGENT: add from arch --> | | | |

## Authentication Test Scenarios

| Scenario | Input | Expected | Priority | Finance Risk |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Valid credentials + TOTP | Correct user, valid 6-digit TOTP | 200, token issued | Critical | |
| Valid credentials, wrong TOTP | Correct user, invalid TOTP | 401, no token | Critical | Fraud |
| Valid credentials, expired TOTP | Correct user, TOTP >30s old | 401 | Critical | |
| TOTP replay | Same TOTP used twice within window | 401 on second use | Critical | Fraud |
| Invalid credentials | Wrong password | 401 | High | Brute force |
| Account lockout | >5 failed attempts | 423 Locked | High | |
| Expired access token | Valid JWT, past `exp` | 401 | High | Session hijack |
| Revoked token | Token in revocation list | 401 | High | |
| Token refresh — valid | Valid refresh token | 200, new access token | High | |
| Token refresh — expired | Expired refresh token | 401, re-auth required | High | |
| MFA bypass attempt | Skip MFA step in flow | 403 | Critical | Fraud |
| <!-- AGENT: add --> | | | | |

## RBAC Test Scenarios

| Role | Permitted | Denied | Test |
|---|---|---|---|
| Customer | Own profile, own KYC status | Other users' data, admin endpoints | Cross-account read attempt |
| KYC Analyst | Read all KYC submissions | Approve/reject (if separate role), delete | Write attempt as analyst |
| KYC Approver | Approve/reject KYC | Delete, admin | Delete attempt as approver |
| Fraud Analyst | Read fraud signals | Modify transaction data | Write attempt |
| Admin | Full access | N/A | Ensure no horizontal escalation |
| Service Account | Defined API scopes only | Cross-scope | Out-of-scope endpoint call |
| <!-- AGENT: add from BRD roles --> | | | |

## KYC Verification Scenarios (Daon)

| Scenario | Document | State | Expected | Priority |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Happy path | Passport | Valid, in-date, name matches | Verified — KYC passed | Critical |
| Expired document | Passport | Expired 1 day ago | Rejected — KYC failed | Critical |
| Expires today | Passport | Expires today | Test acceptance rule | High |
| Name mismatch | Passport | Name differs from account | Rejected — flag for review | Critical |
| DOB mismatch | Passport | DOB differs from account | Rejected | Critical |
| Unsupported document | Utility bill | N/A | Rejected — unsupported type | High |
| Daon sandbox 500 | Any | Provider returns 500 | Graceful failure, retry or safe-fail | High |
| Daon sandbox timeout | Any | Provider times out | Timeout handled, not crash | High |
| Under 18 | Any | DOB < 18 years ago | Rejected — age requirement | Critical |
| Exactly 18 today | Any | DOB = today - 18 years | Test boundary — accept or reject per policy | High |
| <!-- AGENT: add from Daon spec --> | | | | |

## AML Scenarios

| Scenario | Input | Expected | Regulatory |
|---|---|---|---|
| Clean customer | No watchlist, no PEP flag | AML passed | |
| Sanctions watchlist match | Customer on sanctions list | Blocked, alert raised | Yes |
| PEP flag | PEP indicator set | Enhanced due diligence triggered | Yes |
| Transaction velocity — at threshold | X transactions/hour | Allowed | |
| Transaction velocity — above threshold | X+1 transactions/hour | Flagged, review triggered | Yes |
| Large transaction — at reporting threshold | Amount = threshold | Test: report triggered or not per policy | Yes |
| Large transaction — above threshold | Amount > threshold | Regulatory report triggered | Yes |
| <!-- AGENT: add from AML policy --> | | | |

## Fraud Signal Scenarios

| Scenario | Signal | Expected | Priority |
|---|---|---|---|
| Velocity check — boundary | Transactions at limit | Allowed | High |
| Velocity check — breach | Transactions over limit | Flagged | Critical |
| New geography login | Login from country not seen before | Step-up auth triggered | High |
| Known fraud pattern | Pattern match on transaction data | Alert raised, transaction held | Critical |
| Device fingerprint mismatch | Different device from usual | Step-up auth or flag | High |
